newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar closes down but off lows.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar closes down but off lows.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures settled weaker but off the lows as steady speculative buying supported prices throughout the day, trading sources said.
Producer pricing at the day's high of 11.89 cents weighed on the market and blocked the benchmark October contract from hitting the contract high of 11.93 cents reached on Friday.
Analysts chalked today's losses up to a slight technical correction and said the overall trend remains higher based on the longer-term fundamental outlook.
World sugar consumption has been forecast to rise in the coming year while production is not expected to keep pace with demand, analysts said.
In recent weeks, Russian buying of raws has lent support to prices. Nearby resistance was pegged at 11.87 cents followed by 11.93 cents.
Benchmark October sugar settled at 11.82 cents, down 0.04, having ranged from 11.89 to 11.72 cents. The rest of the board closed 0.01 to 0.06 cent lower.
Floor sources said the trade was a light seller of the October/March spread, which closed at 0.18 cent, unchanged from Friday.
An estimated 17,286 lots changed hands compared with Friday's official 35,667 lots.
